audit_items.proof_trace: validate_market correctly implements both required checks: L142 asserts markets.contains(market_key) (type registration) and L143 asserts markets.borrow(market_key) == &object::id(market) (object ID match). All state-changing entry points invoke validate_market directly or via check_market (adl.move:213-219 which delegates to validate_market). The Market::new<MarketType> constructor is public(package), preventing external creation of unregistered Market objects; the sole creation site (register_market) atomically creates and registers the market, so no unregistered Market<MarketType> can exist in practice.
